scope_rows.source: filename fourth field LO/MD/HI; XX means unspecified
scope_rows.notes: Only IEO has LO/MD/HI; all neutral and other sentence clips are XX. Native perceived VoiceLevel is a separate scale, not substituted.

scope_rows.pair_rule: Actor + native emotion + published statement ID + repetition; identical statement across levels.

scope_rows.pair_rule: Session + actor + exact published script_sent text + script_trial + assigned emotion; intensity excluded from key.
scope_rows.notes: Raw values are Low/High; the author README describes normal/strong. Improvised turns have no script intensity; agreement is not intensity.
Mean of 40 listeners' 1-9 emotional-strength ratings. Intensity is not meanIntensity (the latter is acoustic dB). No low/high bins are invented.

native_meralion_audit.interpretation: VAD is not an emotion-strength label. Arousal is calm-to-active; dominance weak-to-strong is control, not expressiveness. Neither class probability nor existing CSVs reconstruct native dims.

parameters.primary_scope: known native intensity, non-neutral original gold, original saved predictions
parameters.intensity_scales: separate native units; never pooled across datasets
parameters.continuous_display: MCAE-SPPS native listener mean; quartiles for plotting only, raw 1-9 score for regression
parameters.fixed_effects: original gold class intercepts; equal gold-class total weights within each dataset
parameters.duration_control: log2(original clip duration) as additional covariate
parameters.intervals: source-cluster CR1 and t(G-1); withheld below 20 source clusters; exploratory, not multiplicity-adjusted
parameters.matched_cases: complete native levels on published take keys; class-balanced high-minus-low accuracy

notes: Classification sensitivity to native strength is not a test of predicted intensity accuracy.
Neutral references and unspecified XX are not weak-emotion examples.
MERaLiON native VAD outputs are absent from saved predictions; no additional inference was performed.
Perceived intensity can covary with rater agreement; acting-level comparisons are not randomized interventions.
